description: A Dockerfile and a Kubernetes Deployment with unpinned images, a baked-in secret, a root container, a privileged pod, host networking and the Docker socket mounted from the host.

vulnerabilities.note: base image uses the mutable latest tag instead of a pinned version or digest
secret value baked into an image layer (fake fixture value)
no USER instruction anywhere, so the process runs as root; anchored on the CMD line
pod shares the node network namespace
container image referenced by the latest tag
host Docker socket mounted into the container
